purpose: People linked to roles, groups and activities

A participant or position row never grants a capability. Keep planned roster and actual attendance distinct. School configuration codes resolve against the pinned snapshot.

Stable activity ID is the root record_id; stage ID is its own record_id. Child stage snapshots and form snapshots remain pinned. Labels contain version keys and rationale.

rule: Immutable rows per exact catalogue snapshot, axis and level; unique on that triple. 128 Skills Builder rows remain 128 rows, not 128 tables. conditions_json holds stable condition IDs, text, evidence rules and sources. New catalogue activation pins the complete step set.

Peer code acceptance creates an explicit respondent/subject task; the code alone grants no access. Derived overdue is not an authoritative stored flag.

purpose: Shared immutable content versions and action/decision history
